title: Legal Document Template
description: Schema for a legal document template the system can programmatically fill and modify for a user. Placeholders in section bodies use {{variable_key}} syntax and map to entries in the variables array.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier for the template.

jurisdiction.description: Primary legal jurisdiction the template is drafted for (ISO country/region code or name). Use 'Generic' when not tied to one.

description.description: Short summary of when to use this template.

license.description: License under which the template text is distributed.

variables.description: Fields the system fills or lets the user modify. Each key maps to {{key}} placeholders in the sections.

key.description: Placeholder key referenced as {{key}} in section bodies.

label.description: UI label shown to the user.

type.description: Input/data type used to render and validate the field.

default.description: Optional default value used when the user leaves the field blank.

options.description: Allowed values for a select field.

sections.description: Ordered document body. Bodies may embed {{variable_key}} placeholders.
